evd_title: All four LLMs included fundamental ICD elements for all seven case scenarios
finding: All four LLMs included fundamental ICD elements for all seven case scenarios
P: 28 LLM-generated informed consent documents (4 LLMs x 7 FERCAP-SIDCER case scenarios)
I: Google Bard, ChatGPT 3.5, Claude-Instant-100k, ChatGPT 4.0; single prompt per case to generate ICD
C: US HHS OHRP informed-consent checklist; 2 author raters with consensus
O: All 4 included fundamental ICD elements in all 7 cases, all <=1250 words; all used jargon; none stated number of participants
T: Not reported on page (FERCAP-SIDCER handbook 2012; paper 2025)
